analysis.summary: The Tenant must pay a security deposit of Rs. 37,500 when signing [p1.c4]. Monthly rent is Rs. 12,500, due by the 7th of every month [p1.c2]. If rent is late by more than 3 days, a late fee of Rs. 300 per day applies [p1.c3]. Either party can end the agreement by giving 30 days written notice [p1.c5].
